paths.title: Microsoft Azure Operations and Governance Specialist
paths.target_role: Azure Engineer / Cloud Engineer / Cloud Architect
entry_prerequisites: Cloud fundamentals, networking basics and enterprise change-control awareness

milestones.rationale: Establish Azure scope, governance and network-control foundations before operational diagnosis.
Build the monitoring/governance control loop, read-only evidence collection and layered troubleshooting.
Validate senior judgement across RBAC, Policy, networking and operations.
Integrate governance, network and observability evidence into a production Azure assurance decision.

paths.dependency_notes: Scope and authorization come first; network and operations evidence follow; integrated production judgement is last.
paths.status_rationale: Physical coverage exists for Azure hierarchy/RBAC/Policy, networking, observability, read-only evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated operations capstone.

paths.title: DevOps / AZ-400 Secure Delivery Specialist
paths.target_role: DevOps Engineer / Platform Engineer / Release Engineer
entry_prerequisites: Source-control fundamentals plus basic Azure and scripting knowledge

milestones.rationale: Establish controlled source, PR and CI/CD delivery mechanics.
Connect supply-chain security, privileged delivery resources, observability and evidence-first troubleshooting.
Validate release-governance and senior delivery judgement.
Integrate commit-to-runtime traceability, independent controls and recovery into a production delivery assurance exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Repository governance precedes pipeline/release controls; runtime verification and recovery are integrated only after artifact and privilege boundaries are understood.
paths.status_rationale: Physical coverage exists for repositories, branch controls, CI/CD, artifacts, environments, security, read-only evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated secure-delivery capstone.

paths.title: AWS Cloud Operations and Governance Specialist
paths.target_role: AWS Engineer / Cloud Engineer / Cloud Architect
entry_prerequisites: Cloud fundamentals, IP networking and least-privilege security concepts

milestones.rationale: Establish Organizations/IAM and VPC control boundaries.
Build CloudWatch/CloudTrail evidence reasoning and layered read-only incident diagnosis.
Validate senior governance, networking and operational judgement.
Integrate account, identity, network, telemetry and audit evidence into production AWS assurance.

paths.dependency_notes: Account and identity boundaries precede network operations; evidence and audit reasoning then lead to integrated production assurance.
paths.status_rationale: Physical coverage exists for Organizations/IAM, VPC controls, observability/audit, read-only evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated AWS capstone.

paths.title: Hybrid and Multi-cloud Infrastructure Specialist
paths.target_role: Hybrid Cloud Engineer / Cloud Architect / Infrastructure Architect
entry_prerequisites: Working Azure and AWS fundamentals plus enterprise networking and identity concepts

milestones.rationale: Establish provider-native governance and cross-environment connectivity foundations.
Build unified-operations evidence and layered hybrid troubleshooting without hiding platform-specific truth.
Validate senior cross-cloud governance, connectivity and resilience judgement.
Integrate ownership, identity, connectivity, observability and shared-dependency recovery into one hybrid assurance exercise.

paths.dependency_notes: Provider-native Azure/AWS knowledge is prerequisite; hybrid governance and connectivity then lead to operations and shared-dependency recovery.
paths.status_rationale: Physical coverage exists for hybrid governance/identity, connectivity, operations, read-only evidence, troubleshooting, assessment, interview judgement and an integrated multi-cloud recovery capstone.
